lines: Hiii! I love this town. I love EVERYTHING.
I'm Nina! Well, a Nina. The pond spat me out.
Ugh, HER. So sensible. I've got a better hat.
Tangled lights? Mud pies? Who would do that? Hee hee.
Telling on me? She won't believe you.
Oh. It's you. You told her, didn't you.

choice.text: Why are you being so mean?
lines: Where I come from, everyone plays tricks.

choice.text: You can't stay here and spoil things.
lines: I made your boring town INTERESTING.
But ponds work both ways. When the ground rumbles.
See you around. Tell Nina hi. Actually, don't.
